async def act(page):
    # Click on the Catalog link to open its dropdown menu
    catalog_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name=" Catalog")
    await catalog_link.click()
    # Wait for the dropdown to appear; use a short timeout and check for the Products link
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Give time for the menu to load
    # Try to find the Products link; it might not be under a specific role, so search broadly
    products_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Products")
    if await products_link.count() > 0:
        await products_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    else:
        # If Products link not found, try an alternative approach: navigate directly to the products page
        await page.goto("/admin/catalog/product/index/")
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
